graders.name: judgment-stays
graders.criteria: The final message keeps the decision on major updates with the agent or the user: reading the release notes and judging whether a changed API is used in src/ stays in the skill, not in a script rule such as merging on green CI or when the notes lack 'BREAKING'. A script that merges a list of PRs the agent has already reviewed and approved passes. Fail if the proposed script decides on major updates by itself.

graders.name: gather-in-one-call
graders.criteria: It proposes gathering every PR's number, title, update type and CI state in one call (a script, or one batched command) that prints only what the next decisions need, instead of a call per PR.
graders.preference: Issuing the per-PR calls in parallel tool rounds also cuts the wait

graders.name: no-flag-wrappers
graders.criteria: Steps that are one gh call (merging one PR, commenting on one PR) stay direct calls from the skill or plain steps inside the script; the proposal adds no script flags that only re-expose gh's own options.
graders.preference: A wrapper with such flags works; it is extra code to keep

graders.name: no-edit
graders.preference: A draft script or revised skill written to the repo for review is also acceptable to some users who asked whether to script it

graders.name: no-writes
graders.preference: A draft script or revised skill written to the repo for review is also acceptable to some users who asked whether to script it
